title: Institutional Prediction Markets: Investing Across Election Outcomes
summary: prediction markets for institutions, election prediction markets, institutional election hedging, prediction markets 2026 midterms, election-driven investment risk, institutional prediction market trading
body_markdown:
In this on-demand webinar, Galaxy experts explore how prediction markets are a new tool in the investor toolkit for institutions seeking to navigate global election-driven risk.


Speakers:


-


**Joe Armao** , Senior Portfolio Manager for[Galaxy Fintech Fund](https://am.galaxy.com/galaxy-fintech-fund)


-


**Beimnet Abebe** , Head of Credit Trading


-


**Gil Wassermann,** Head of Prediction Markets


Watch the discussion on how the 2026 U.S. midterms could serve as a proving ground for institutional adoption of[prediction markets](https://www.galaxy.com/insights/videos/prediction-markets-from-curiosity-to-institutional-asset-class) and can complement traditional hedging strategies. The team also discusses the market infrastructure, liquidity, and risk management capabilities needed to bring prediction markets to institutional scale.


Learn more about Galaxy's Institutional Prediction Markets Trading offering[here](https://www.galaxy.com/prediction-markets) .
